details: The preflight called require_runner_route_compat(api_family) with an implicit v2 default and treated any HTTP 200 /api/config, including JSON null or malformed JSON, as v2. The exact retained OpenCode config was HTTP 200 JSON array while the previous runner selected v22 and used POST /session, which returned 405 and the prior create operation became UNKNOWN. QOCPREFLIGHT now compares the server read-only family with nativeProtocol from the exact runner initialize response and fails closed on unknown/malformed selection. Offline regression evidence is stored in QOCPREFLIGHT-red.txt and QOCPREFLIGHT-green.txt; no native create/send was run.
